description: Chinese humanoid robot beats 100-meter world record Host: China's second World Humanoid Robot Games is underway in Beijing, where more than 2,000 robots are participating in events such as boxing and sprints, as well as household tasks and even firefighting. The teams taking part in the competition represent companies rather than countries, and one of them, the Chinese smartphone maker Honor, says its humanoid robot has broken the world record for the 100-metre sprint set by Usain Bolt 17 years…
classificationReason: 报道中国人形机器人赛事、百米竞速、家务任务及从展示走向实用的挑战。
